maddeler.e:
يفترضوا (form VIII)
# يَفْتَرِضُوا (yaftariḍū) /jaf.ta.ri.dˤuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِفْتَرَضَ (iftaraḍa)
# يُفْتَرَضُوا (yuftaraḍū) /juf.ta.ra.dˤuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِفْتَرَضَ (iftaraḍa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
